feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Bomb found near ethanol plant in central Illinois forces evacuations
entry.summary: The bomb was discovered Friday afternoon at the BioUrja Renewables plant in Peoria. Officials say the bomb has been "rendered safe," but called it a "credible threat." The FBI is investigating.

entry.title: FAA blames Friday's ground stop on 'equipment issue' during telecoms network upgrade
entry.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said initial investigations pointed to an issue with contractor L3Harris updating old tech at a remote location.

entry.title: Stuck in airports nationwide, stranded travelers share how they're coping
entry.summary: People all over the country found themselves stuck in airports last night. We hear from some stranded travelers about how they're coping.

entry.title: Over 30 injured, no fatalities after tanker strikes cruise ship in New Orleans
entry.summary: There were more than 30 injuries but no fatalities after a tanker hit a cruise ship in the Port of New Orleans Friday.

entry.title: Hegseth's failed impeachment was a warning to Democrats. Where will they go from here?
entry.summary: Democrats have been given a huge opportunity with majorities in both the House and Senate — but the balance of priorities, timing, messaging and discipline are all going to be major tests.

entry.title: As Democrats win big, thirst traps of male candidates take social media by storm
entry.summary: It's everywhere on social media: Democrats celebrating the attractive men voters elected in the midterms. But it's bigger than a meme and says a lot about politics of masculinity in the age of Trump.

entry.title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins race for Alaska governor, replaces a Republican
entry.summary: Kreiss-Tomkins, a former state legislator, ran a campaign emphasizing bipartisanship in the the state that usually votes Republican. At 37, he'll be the youngest governor in the state's history.

entry.title: Stuck on the tarmac without information: Travelers share their ground stop experiences
entry.summary: Passengers stuck on airplanes on tarmacs across the country during the FAA ground stop on Friday share their stories.

entry.title: What we know about the FAA nationwide ground stop
entry.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration took an extraordinary step Friday afternoon by issuing a nationwide ground stop. No planes are taking off at any airport and millions of passengers are stranded.

entry.title: Old tech blamed for the ground stop that caused flight chaos: 'It got overloaded'
entry.summary: The nationwide ground stop that paralyzed the U.S. aviation system on Friday has ended, according to Federal Aviation Administration.
